mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Verona Community Park, and while the temperature is 45 degrees, it feels more like 39. We are currently under a waxing gibbous moon, and tonight will see an overnight low of 40 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is working on a space needs evaluation for the Public Works and Utilities facility to accommodate future expansion and improve service efficiency. Additionally, construction continues on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which is currently focused on curb and sidewalk installation.
We have a busy schedule ahead! Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or check out ART House 360. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or join the trivia night at Hop Haus.
Looking at the report from November 6, officers responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue where they found a driver passed out; she was subsequently arrested for O W I.

We hope you enjoyed today's Double Strawberry flavor! We are currently closed for the night, but we look forward to serving you tomorrow's flavor, Really Reese's, when our doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
